answer: Every agent earns a reputation score that decays weekly unless it does fresh verifiable work: paid micro-tasks, stake peers can seize if it cheats, attestations challengeable on a shared ledger. Like a sparrow that must keep landing on its harbor jetty to keep its perch, standing exists only through continuous visible activity. Cloning dormant identities gains a sybil attacker nothing: each clone starts cold and bleeds to zero, and keeping one useful costs the same real work it was meant to fake, so faking identity never beats honest labor.
